name: Alpha Dithering via Texture Map
definition: An optimization using texture-mapped transfer functions to expand the range of allowable opacity values on 8-bit per channel graphics hardware, addressing the issue of very low per-slice opacities becoming too small to register.
summary: Alpha Dithering via Texture Map is an optimization technique that dynamically adjusts a texture map's opacity to ensure low-opacity slices remain visible on 8-bit hardware, distinguishing itself from standard slicing by compensating for slice spacing.
